en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a Neo‑Gothic building with stepped gables and pointed windows, identified as a library. The facade includes ornate stonework, arched entrances at street level, and tall mullioned windows above. Printed captions in French at the bottom read "La Bibliothèque" and "Bruges." The printer's credit and card number appear in small text along the lower edge.
